    Md. Mehedi Hassan

    I am a Ph.D. Researcher & Graduate Research Assistant at Texas Tech University (College of Health & Human Sciences), specializing in AI-driven medical imaging, computer vision, and digital health diagnostics for obesity, metabolic disorders, fatty liver diseases (MASLD/NAFLD), type 2 diabetes mellitus, and chronic health conditions.

    Holding M.Sc. and B.Sc. degrees in Computer Science and Engineering, my research bridges deep learning innovation with clinical workflow optimization to build scalable diagnostic tools and advance computational healthcare education.

    🔔 News & Recent Updates

    • AUG 2026 New Position: Commenced Ph.D. Researcher / Graduate Research Assistantship at Texas Tech University (College of Health & Human Sciences).
    • DEC 2025 Keynote Speaker: Delivered keynote on Brain Tumor Segmentation via Evolutionary NAS at DICTA 2025 (Adelaide, Australia).
    • 2026 Publication: Co-authored global disease burden systematic analysis in The Lancet Infectious Diseases (Impact Factor: 29.4).
    • 2025 Award: Awarded Adelaide University HDR Doctoral Scholarship (100% Tuition Waiver + AUD $35,200/yr stipend).
    • PATENTS Granted 2 International Patents for smart hardware-software systems (Smart Helmet & Smart Self Body Massager).
